_comment: Migrated 2026-08-17 (XOT-next): this project's own tooling now reads this file directly via repoman's config.py -- scripts/{ed,roles,register,guards,syncver,wave_progress,add_wave,str_replace_extended}.py are repoman's own generalised versions, not hand-forked copies. id_prefix/id_separator/legacy_id_prefix/legacy_id_separator encode the same T-/XOT- dual-format rule documented at length in this project's own TRACKING.md and RESOLVED.md; wave_short_names/wave_themes were migrated verbatim from wave_progress.py's own former hardcoded dicts. release.py remains this project's own -- its 12-step pipeline (sharded testing, c04dcheck, critrepro, generate, consistency, gate) has no equivalent in relcore.py's own two generic builtins, and wrapping it is real, separately-scoped work, not done here.
